name: agrinews-autotest
description: Standalone automation test suite — runs inside the playwright container and tests the live app as a black box (UI via browser + API via HTTP). No access to frontend/backend source code.

scripts.test: docker exec agrinews-playwright-1 npx playwright test
scripts.test:ui: docker exec agrinews-playwright-1 npx playwright test --project=ui
scripts.test:api: docker exec agrinews-playwright-1 npx playwright test --project=api
scripts.test:headed: docker exec agrinews-playwright-1 npx playwright test --project=ui --headed
scripts.test:debug: docker exec -it agrinews-playwright-1 npx playwright test --debug
scripts.report:serve: docker exec agrinews-playwright-1 npx playwright show-report reports/results/playwright-report --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9323
